Aisha Salazar
aisha.salazar@example.com | Tucson, AZ
Aisha Salazar has 15 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Meridian Software (2025-2026),
where they designed a Node.js-backed data layer that cut p99 query latency by
50%. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Ironwood Solutions (2021-2025).
Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Timberline Analytics (2011-2021).
Education: B.S. Electrical Engineering, San Jose State University, 2010. Core
skills: Redis, TypeScript, AWS, REST API design, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes,
Node.js.
